approved_by: user, 2026-10-08, before any stage-2 signal or return was examined
question: Does trading implied vol against a HAR forecast of realized vol, with defined-risk option structures, beat an always-on version of the same structure and cash after realistic option costs, out of sample?

inputs.start: 2022-03-01 (HAR forecasts need a year of history)

universe: each calendar month, the 12 V8-pool names (tech members of that month or the fixed ETFs) with the largest PIT 63-day median option dollar volume score from the latest PIT freeze available before the month (nn_meta/validation/v8-pit-20261007-r0/membership.parquet)

signal.ratio: iv30 / har_vol on trading day t (both known at t's close)

execution.timing: a signal on day t trades at day t+1's closing prices (the next trading day)
execution.expiry: the listed expiry with DTE closest to 30 within 21-45 calendar days
execution.forward_and_move: F = put-call-parity forward of that expiry on the entry day; expected move EM = S x iv30 x sqrt(DTE/365) (entry-day iv30)
execution.strikes: nearest listed strike to each target
execution.contract_filter: every leg traded that day (volume >= 1) with close >= $0.50; otherwise no trade
execution.price: leg close +/- k x half-spread, half-spread = median spread % of mid / 2 from nn_meta/validation/v8-spreads-option-20261008-r0/model.json bucket table (price x DTE x OTM; missing cell -> that price bucket's median), plus $0.05 per contract per leg at entry; k = 1.0 primary, 1.5 stress
execution.exit: held to expiry, settled at intrinsic value from the underlying's raw close on the last trading day on or before expiry; no early assignment modelled; trades whose expiry falls after 2025-12-31 are not entered, so no holdout price is read

structures.ib_w1.0: short ATM call + put at the strike nearest F; long call/put nearest F +/- 1.0 EM
structures.ib_w1.5: short ATM call + put; long wings nearest F +/- 1.5 EM
structures.ic_1.0_1.5: short call nearest F + 1.0 EM, short put nearest F - 1.0 EM; long wings nearest F +/- 1.5 EM
structures.straddle: long ATM call + put (long vol only)

variants: 12 short-vol (3 structures x 4 theta_high) + 3 long-vol (straddle x 3 theta_low) = 15
sizing: each trade risks 2% of current equity at its maximum loss (wing width minus credit; straddle: debit), fractional units; P&L booked at expiry; Kelly out of scope

evaluation.returns: daily equity (cash basis, P&L at settlement) from 2022-03-01
evaluation.in_sample: expanding from 2022-03-01 to the day before each fold
evaluation.selection: highest in-sample annualized Sharpe among the 15 variants with >= 30 in-sample trades (by entry date)
benchmarks: always-on: the selected variant's structure entered whenever a universe name is flat (no signal), same sizing and costs

pass_rules_all_required.beat_benchmarks: selected variant's fold return exceeds both its always-on benchmark and 0 in >= 4 of 6 folds at k = 1.0
pass_rules_all_required.rank_persistence: Spearman(in-sample Sharpe, out-of-sample Sharpe) across eligible variants positive in >= 4 of 6 folds, median >= 0.10
pass_rules_all_required.deflated_sharpe: probability >= 0.95 for the concatenated selected out-of-sample daily returns, N = 15
pass_rules_all_required.pbo: CSCV PBO < 0.5 over 2022-03-01..2025-12-31 daily returns of the 15 variants, 16 blocks
pass_rules_all_required.cost_stress: beat_benchmarks still holds when rerun at k = 1.5

limitations: Prices are daily last trades, not quotes; the bucket spread model sets costs.
European-style settlement at intrinsic; early assignment and pin risk not modelled.
Cash-basis P&L understates interim drawdowns of open trades.
if_nothing_passes: Record the verdict; V8 has then found no edge in direction or volatility, and the next step is decided with the user.
